Because to me it is having hard time catching up with head it always up and running. As I can see your geth nodes synced with head yep it's true for some reason, our node takes long time to import blocks. probably, it is because of slow ssd. we run our node on DigitalOcean ok. And blocks are really big Approximately a block of 473M gas every 5 blocks. This is my tool that generates account and entries in the storage So I guess this node won't be usable for performance tests It will probably crash This may be in the wrong category but is there any talks on eip 3143 on discord currently? This is definitely not the right channel, but this really isn't the right *server* unless you want to talk about the implementation details (which would be surprising since it is just a copy/paste of previous block reward change proposals). You can use the discussions-to link if you want to discuss the content of the proposal. Thank you micah
